purpose: Initial pricing recommendation and validation frame for Launchpad Lint.

sources.notes: Design brief for the first external product candidate.
Marketplace state and fixed per-call pricing constraint.
Value model and price sensitivity framing.

content.body: Initial recommendation: `$0.09` per successful call, assuming a typical first-use flow of one audit call and one launch-package draft call.
This price is intended to preserve low-friction first-use while still signaling that the product provides real workflow leverage.
Do not add tiers or freemium complexity in V1. Use the native per-call model and learn from real usage first.
Judge the price against install-to-first-paid-call, first useful session completion, and repeat usage, not against abstract willingness-to-pay claims.

promotion.notes: First pricing recommendation for Launchpad Lint under AgenticMarket's fixed per-call model.
